_doc: Which canonical jobs (game/data/canonical/jobs.json) are playable in this build and what advancing grants (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md section 9). A job missing here is not playable with default_reason. Optional level overrides the canonical advancement level for survivor mode; an option above the player's level shows level_reason instead. grants.max_mp adds to computed base Max MP (Improved MaxMP Increase preserves the current MP ratio on growth). grants.max_hp (added to base Max HP, like level growth) is supported alongside max_mp. format1_weapon (tier C, frozen spec #32 rule) is the weapon CharacterSnapshot.migrate gives a format-1 character of that job line, the nearest ancestor's entry; new jobs need none. No job grants skills. Accepting a job opens an extra advancement skill draw before the level's normal draw; canonical skill prerequisites are ignored (tier C owner choice #31).
